{{Quote|What makes you think Fey'lya's got contacts on New Cov?''"<br />"''Because during the war, this was the only place his Bothans ever seemed to care about defending.|Han Solo and Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
The '''Raid on New Cov''' was a small attack launched by the forces of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to capture [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

==Prelude==
In order to find [[Delta Source]], the believed source in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] that is spying for Thrawn, and prove the innocence of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] tried to find evidence at the planet [[New Cov/Legends|New Cov]]. They chose to go to New Cov because it was one of the only planets the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] [[Battle of New Cov|defended]] personally during the entire [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==The Mission==
[[File:Stormtroopers_Ilic.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Stormtroopers in Ilic]]

At [[Ilic]], they first discovered the presence of [[Tav Breil'lya]], one of Senator [[Borsk Fey'lya]]'s advisers, and believed that he was a traitor to the New Republic for Thrawn, and is thus a primary suspect for Delta Source. They followed him and met the contacts of the Bothan: [[Irenez (Human)|Irenez]] and [[Sena Leikvold Midanyl|Sena]].

But before Han, Lando and Luke could find any real evidence to whether or not Fey'lya's adviser was a traitor, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces had arrived on the planet.

[[File:Dreadnaughts_New_Cov.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The ''Dreadnaught'' cruisers]]

The Imperial forces regularly raided Ilic to obtain drugs and medicines&mdash;a cover for the city's clandestine payments to [[Thrawn's confederation]]&mdash;but they discovered the [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']] and Luke's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] and consequently the presence of the former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Some [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] tried to catch them in the hangars but they eventually managed to escape in their [[Starship/Legends|starships]],

==Space Battle==
In space, Luke engaged the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] with his X-wing while Han and Lando tried to escape the [[Churba system|system]] in the ''Lady Luck''. They were saved by a third party with the arrival of three [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]]

==Aftermath==
Luke Skywalker left them to go to [[Jomark/Legends|Jomark]] in order to meet [[Joruus C'baoth]].

Meanwhile, Han Solo and Lando Calrissian were taken by a ''Dreadnaught'' cruisers to an unknown location, ''[[Peregrine's Nest]]'', where they meet the legendary [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], one of the initial founders of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Bothan Tav Breil'lya was in fact on New Cov to organize a meeting between Borsk Fey'lya and Bel Iblis with the aim to rally him to Fey'lya's political faction.

Han Solo and Lando later convinced Garm Bel Iblis to join the new Republic.
